content.text:
The line under the combined Chain tab is fixed. I found the cause, reproduced it in a test, and changed the drawing so nothing draws a line there any more. The test catches the old bug.

**Why it came and went:** the Chain tab sat in its own gpui-kit tab bar, and a tab bar always draws a line along its bottom.
